documentation: Roles hidden in User Management unless the viewer holds them.
name: RestrictedRoles

documentation: Roles & Permissions rows only some roles manage: 'Devices/Actions:RoleA|RoleB', comma-separated (device-perms 2026-10-24; role-wizard v7: BOTH Ticket Logger rows are OneShot only on the page - Use stays ticked for every role, Settings is OneShot only). A restricted row is not given to FullPermissionRoles implicitly (only its ticks count) and the Roles & Permissions page shows / saves it only for viewers holding one of its roles (saves by other viewers never touch it). shared.Security.restrictedRows / rowVisible.
name: RestrictedRows

documentation: Roles that see Ticket Logger > Integrations (API endpoints, tokens, Test Connection) - session.custom.IntegrationAccess.
name: IntegrationRoles

documentation: Informational since 2026-10-01 (security tiers): read only = no Faceplates/Operate tick in [default]_Config/RolesPermissions for any of the user's roles (session.custom.ReadOnly). Kept for reference; not used for gating.
name: ReadOnlyRoles

documentation: Role inheritance for the Roles & Permissions matrix: 'A:B' = role A also gets every tick of role B (comma-separated pairs, chains follow, case-insensitive). Engineering:Maintenance keeps Engineering a superset of Maintenance (user 2026-10-01). Used by shared.Security.permissions (session.custom.Permissions, server checks).
name: RoleInherits

documentation: security-tiers builder: last one-time matrix decision set applied (see DECISIONS in .cursor/tasks/security-tiers/build.py). Not used by the HMI.
name: TierSeedVersion

documentation: device-perms (2026-10-24): UDT TypeId -> Roles & Permissions Devices value. A device control needs its general row AND <Device>/<Action> when that row exists (no row = general only). shared.Security.deviceOf (server) and view.custom.permDevice (faceplates). New Devices/* types are appended by .cursor/tasks/security-tiers/build.py with their own name.
name: DeviceTypes

documentation: Roles that are HMI administrators (session.custom.Administrator: User Management / Roles & Permissions pages besides the matrix rows, legacy adminOnly nav items). Comma-separated, case-insensitive. Faceplates, Engineering, Audit Log, Out Of Service and locked trends are matrix rows (security tiers 2026-10-01).
name: AdminRoles

documentation: UNUSED since 2026-10-24 (device-perms): the Ticket Logger is gated by the Roles & Permissions rows TicketLogger/Use (every role; session.custom.TicketLogAccess) and TicketLogger/Settings (OneShot only). Kept for reference only.
name: TicketLoggerRoles

documentation: device-perms (2026-10-24): which device-type row (<Device>/<Action>) a server-side write needs. Pattern = Python regex searched in the member path below the device instance (e.g. 'Motor/OCmd_Start/Value'); first match wins; no match = Setpoint (Setpoint and Configuration stand in for each other when a type has only one). shared.Security.actionOf; see docs/security-roles.md.
name: DeviceActionRules
